english.text: The project envisions a future where human explorers can bring a compact habitat built out of a lightweight material with dormant fungi that will last on long journeys to places like Mars. Upon arrival, by unfolding that basic structure and simply adding water, the fungi will be able to grow around that framework into a fully functional human habitat – all while being safely contained within the habitat to avoid contaminating the Martian environment.

text: 呢個項目設想咗一個未來，人類探險家可以帶嚟一個由輕量材料同休眠真菌建造嘅緊湊棲息地，呢個棲息地可以喺去火星等地方嘅長途旅程中持續，到達火星嗰陣，只要展開嗰個基本結構同埋簡單噉加水，真菌就會成為 能夠圍繞呢個框架成長成為一個功能齊全嘅人類棲息地 —— 同時安全地被包含喺棲息地內，以避免污染火星環境。
